name: Packet Scheduling and Operating-Region Evaluation
purpose: Measure the realized packet-level value of trajectory prediction under identical traffic and link conditions.
work_items: run paired policy episodes with shared scenario and traffic seeds
compare learned objectives under identical scheduler logic
evaluate straight, approaching/receding, lane-change/merge, turn, FoV-edge and dense slices
acceptance_criteria: every comparison is paired on scenario and traffic realization
all policies use the same ground-truth link realization for scoring
learned-vs-reactive and learned-vs-classical comparisons are available
information oracle uses the same heuristic family and differs only by future information
all main sweeps and scenario slices are complete
raw results retain scenario and seed identifiers
forbidden: changing traffic realizations between compared policies
using predicted link state as ground truth for scoring
reporting only regimes where predictive scheduling wins
